newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end firm on unfilled CANTV bids.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end firm on unfilled CANTV bids.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed ahead as investors bought shares with spare cash left over from unfilled orders for CANTV shares, brokers said.
The Venezuelan government is nearing the end of its local issue of 50 million shares in telephone company CANTV.
"The market accelerated away in the morning, but then fell away on a little bout of profit-taking," said Banesco broker Simon Brad.
The bolsa's .IBC index closed up 0.61 percent at 5,997.91 points as 20 shares rose, eight fell and 13 closed flat.
Heavy trade in market leader Electricidad de Caracas topped 4.3 million shares as over the session a total of 17.5 million shares worth 3.6 billion bolivars ($7.7 million) changed hands .
Electricidad closed flat at 540.00 bolivars. Steel company Sivensa rose 8.00 bolivars to end at 332.00, and foods producer Mavesa rose 1.50 bolivars to finish at 155.50.
